info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Eligibility Inquiry API provides access to specific customer management data based on given parameters. This API enables businesses to evaluate product eligibility for customers, helping them offer tailored financial services effectively. Typical consumers include financial institutions and customer service teams looking to enhance user experience and decision-making through personalized offerings. The endpoint allows users to retrieve information using a specified parameter, facilitating efficient access to critical customer data.

get.summary: Retrieve product eligibility for a specific customer
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the product eligibility details for a customer identified by their unique ID. Use this to determine which products a customer qualifies for based on their profile and preferences.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to query the eligibility of a product for a specified customer, identified by the unique customer ID CUST-100045. It allows the client to request detailed information regarding the product suitability and availability for the customer in question.

200.description: Successful retrieval of product eligibility details.

GetCustomerManagementByParam1Request.description: A JSON string that represents the request body for fetching product eligibility for a specific customer operation.
